reason: A Windows computer-use plugin for agent-driven desktop observation and interaction, including screenshots, pointer and keyboard control, and optional screenshot analysis through a configured vision API.

summaries.zh: 为智能体提供 Windows 桌面截图、鼠标键盘控制、等待操作以及通过配置的视觉 API 分析屏幕内容的计算机使用工具。
summaries.en: Provides agent-oriented Windows desktop screenshots, mouse and keyboard control, wait operations, and optional screen analysis through a configured vision API.

capabilities: Controls pointer and keyboard input within bounded desktop coordinates
Sends configured text and keyboard shortcuts to the active control
Sends screenshots to a user-configured OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint
